create_MultiTokenCLIPTokenizer: create a MultiTokenCLIPTokenizer instance that extends CLIPTokenizer with multi-token placeholder support
add_placeholder_tokens: add placeholder tokens to the tokenizer with configurable number of vectors per token
replace_placeholder_tokens_in_text: replace placeholder tokens in text with their underlying token sequences for encoding
call_MultiTokenCLIPTokenizer: call the tokenizer on text to automatically expand placeholders and return tokenized output
encode_MultiTokenCLIPTokenizer: encode text through the tokenizer with automatic placeholder expansion and vector shuffle support
